scripts.build: npm run wasm:release && vue-tsc -b && vite build
scripts.wasm: wasm-pack build engine/crates/web --target web --out-dir ../../pkg --dev && wasm-pack build engine/crates/worker --target web --out-dir ../../pkg-worker --dev
scripts.wasm:release: wasm-pack build engine/crates/web --target web --out-dir ../../pkg --release && wasm-pack build engine/crates/worker --target web --out-dir ../../pkg-worker --release
